name: Southport
blurb: Southport is the Gold Coast's central business district, with a mix of older Queenslanders and high-rise apartments — both known for ageing pipework that fails without warning.

name: Surfers Paradise
blurb: Surfers Paradise runs on high-density apartment living, where a single burst pipe or blocked stack can affect multiple units fast.

name: Burleigh Heads
blurb: Burleigh Heads mixes beachside homes and hillside properties, where tree-root intrusion into sewer lines is a common cause of blocked drains.
